You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd project\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'}

# Corrected filing data - NVDA fiscal year ends in January
# FY2024 Q1 = Jan-Mar (2023Q1), FY2024 Q2 = Apr-Jun (2023Q2)
# FY2024 Q3 = Jul-Sep (2023Q3), FY2024 Q4 = Oct-Dec (2023Q4)
# FY2025 Q1 = Jan-Mar (2024Q1), FY2025 Q2 = Apr-Jun (2024Q2)
# FY2025 Q3 = Jul-Sep (2024Q3), FY2025 Q4 = Oct-Dec (2024Q4)

filing_map = {
    '2023Q1': ('23000093', 'nvda-20230430.htm'),  # FY2024 Q1 10-Q
    '2023Q2': ('23000175', 'nvda-20230730.htm'),  # FY2024 Q2 10-Q
    '2023Q3': ('23000227', 'nvda-20240128.htm'),  # FY2024 Q3 10-Q
    '2023Q4': ('24000124', 'nvda-20240428.htm'),  # FY2024 Q4 10-Q
    '2024Q1': ('24000264', 'nvda-20240728.htm'),  # FY2025 Q1 10-Q
    '2024Q2': ('24000316', 'nvda-20241027.htm'),  # FY2025 Q2 10-Q
}

for q, (acc_last6, html_file) in filing_map.items():

            lines = text.split('\n')
            in_table = False
            table_lines = []
            for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                if 'basic and diluted' in line.lower() and 'reconciliation' in line.lower():
                    in_table = True
                if in_table and 'basic weighted average shares' in line.lower():
                    # Collect the values - they should be on the next few lines
                    table_lines = []
                    table_lines.append(line)
                    for j in range(i+1, min(i+10, len(lines))):
                        next_line = lines[j].strip()
                        if not next_line:
                            continue
                        table_lines.append(lines[j])
                        if 'net income' in lines[j].lower() or 'per share' in lines[j].lower() and 'basic' in lines[j].lower():
                            break
                        if ')' in next_line and '%' in next_line:
                            break
                    print(f'\n=== {q} ===')
                    for tl in table_lines:
                        print(f'  {tl[:150]}')
                    break
        else:
            print(f'{q}: HTTP {r.status_code}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{q}: Error - {e}')

print('\nCalculating holding ratios...')

# =============================================

print('Loading template...')
wb = load_workbook('/app/results_template.xlsx')

# =============================================
# Sheet 1: Basic Info & Holding Trend
# =============================================
print('\nFilling Sheet 1: Basic Info & Holding Trend...')
ws1 = wb['Basic Info & Holding Trend']
ws1['A1'] = 'Quarter'
ws1['B1'] = 'NVDA End-of-Quarter Stock Price (USD)'
ws1['C1'] = 'Outstanding Shares (Million Shares)'
ws1['D1'] = 'Market Cap (Billion USD)'
ws1['E1'] = 'Top 20 Shareholders Total Holding Ratio (%)'
ws1['F1'] = 'Top 10 Shareholders Total Holding Ratio (%)'
ws1['G1'] = 'Top 5 Shareholders Total Holding Ratio (%)'
ws1['H1'] = 'Top 20 Shareholders QoQ Holding Ratio Change (%)'

# Write quarter data
prev_total_ratio = 0
for qi, q in enumerate(quarters):
    row = qi + 2
    ws1[f'A{row}'] = q
    ws1[f'B{row}'] = round(prices[q], 2)
    ws1[f'C{row}'] = round(shares_outstanding[q], 2)
    ws1[f'D{row}'] = round(market_caps[q], 2)
    
    # Calculate holding ratios
    holders = shareholders_data[q]
    top5_ratio = round(sum(h[0] for h in holders[:5]) / shares_outstanding[q] * 100, 2)
    top10_ratio = round(sum(h[0] for h in holders[:10]) / shares_outstanding[q] * 100, 2)
    top20_ratio = round(sum(h[0] for h in holders) / shares_outstanding[q] * 100, 2)
    
    ws1[f'E{row}'] = top20_ratio
    ws1[f'F{row}'] = top10_ratio
    ws1[f'G{row}'] = top5_ratio
    
    if qi == 0:
        ws1[f'H{row}'] = 'N/A'
    else:
        qoq_change = round(top20_ratio - prev_total_ratio, 2)
        ws1[f'H{row}'] = qoq_change
    
    prev_total_ratio = top20_ratio
    print(f'  {q}: Top5={top5_ratio}% Top10={top10_ratio}% Top20={top20_ratio}% QoQ={ws1[f"H{row}"]}')

# =============================================
# Sheet 2: Top 20 Key Shareholders Details
# =============================================
print('\nFilling Sheet 2: Top 20 Key Shareholders Details...')
ws2 = wb['Top 20 Key Shareholders Details']
ws2['A1'] = 'Quarter'
ws2['B1'] = 'Shareholder Name'
ws2['C1'] = 'Shares Held (Million Shares)'
ws2['D1'] = 'Holding Value (Billion USD)'
ws2['E1'] = 'Holding Ratio (%)'
ws2['F1'] = 'Change from Last Quarter (Million Shares)'
ws2['G1'] = 'Change Type (New/Increase/Decrease/Exit)'

# Track previous holdings for change calculation
prev_quarter_data = None
row_num = 2
for qi, q in enumerate(quarters):
    holders = shareholders_data[q]
    for hi, h in enumerate(holders):
        name = h[0]
        shares = h[1]
        price = prices[q]
        value = round(shares * price / 1000, 2)  # Million shares * $/share = millions, / 1000 = billions
        ratio = round(shares / shares_outstanding[q] * 100, 2)
        
        change_type = h[4] if len(h) > 4 else 'N/A'
        change_millions = ''
        
        if prev_quarter_data and name in prev_quarter_data:
            prev_shares = prev_quarter_data[name]
            change_millions = round(shares - prev_shares, 2)
            if change_millions > 0:
                change_type = 'Increase'
            elif change_millions < 0:
                change_type = 'Decrease'
            else:
                change_type = 'Unchanged'
        else:
            if prev_quarter_data is None:
                change_type = 'New'
            change_millions = 0
        
        ws2[f'A{row_num}'] = q
        ws2[f'B{row_num}'] = name
        ws2[f'C{row_num}'] = round(shares, 2)
        ws2[f'D{row_num}'] = value
        ws2[f'E{row_num}'] = ratio
        ws2[f'F{row_num}'] = change_millions
        ws2[f'G{row_num}'] = change_type
        row_num += 1
    
    prev_quarter_data = {h[0]: h[1] for h in holders}
    print(f'  {q}: {len(holders)} shareholders')

# =============================================
# Sheet 3: Position Adjustment Summary
# =============================================
print('\nFilling Sheet 3: Position Adjustment Summary...')
ws3 = wb['Position Adjustment Summary']
ws3['A1'] = 'Quarter'
ws3['B1'] = 'New Entry Shareholders Count'
ws3['C1'] = 'Increase Shareholders Count'
ws3['D1'] = 'Decrease Shareholders Count'
ws3['E1'] = 'Exit Shareholders Count'
ws3['F1'] = 'Net Increase Shareholders (Increase - Decrease)'
ws3['G1'] = 'Large Adjustment Count (Over 10M Shares)'
ws3['H1'] = 'Quarterly Net Fund Inflow (Billion USD)'

prev_quarter_data = None
for qi, q in enumerate(quarters):
    row = qi + 2
    holders = shareholders_data[q]
    current_holders = {h[0]: h[1] for h in holders}
    
    new_count = 0
    increase_count = 0
    decrease_count = 0
    exit_count = 0
    large_adj_count = 0
    net_inflow = 0
    
    if prev_quarter_data:
        for name, shares in current_holders.items():
            if name in prev_quarter_data:
                change = shares - prev_quarter_data[name]
                if change > 0:
                    increase_count += 1
                    large_adj_count += 1 if abs(change) > 10 else 0
                    net_inflow += change * prices[q] / 1000  # Billion USD
                elif change < 0:
                    decrease_count += 1
                    large_adj_count += 1 if abs(change) > 10 else 0
                    net_inflow += change * prices[q] / 1000  # Billion USD
            else:
                new_count += 1
                net_inflow += shares * prices[q] / 1000
        
        for name in prev_quarter_data:
            if name not in current_holders:
                exit_count += 1
    else:
        new_count = len(holders)
        net_inflow = sum(h[1] * prices[q] / 1000 for h in holders)
    
    ws3[f'A{row}'] = q
    ws3[f'B{row}'] = new_count
    ws3[f'C{row}'] = increase_count
    ws3[f'D{row}'] = decrease_count
    ws3[f'E{row}'] = exit_count
    ws3[f'F{row}'] = increase_count - decrease_count
    ws3[f'G{row}'] = large_adj_count
    ws3[f'H{row}'] = round(net_inflow, 2)
    print(f'  {q}: New={new_count} Inc={increase_count} Dec={decrease_count} Exit={exit_count}')
    
    prev_quarter_data = current_holders

# Find top 5 most active adjustment institutions (sum of absolute changes)
all_changes = {}
for q in quarters:
    holders = shareholders_data[q]
    current = {h[0]: h[1] for h in holders}
    if prev_quarter_data:
        for name, shares in current.items():
            if name in prev_quarter_data:
                change = abs(shares - prev_quarter_data[name])
                all_changes[name] = all_changes.get(name, 0) + change

# Sort by total change
sorted_active = sorted(all_changes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
top5_active = [s[0] for s in sorted_active[:5]]

# Find institutions with continuous increase
continuous_increasers = set()
for q in quarters:
    holders = shareholders_data[q]
    current = {h[0]: h[1] for h in holders}
    for name, shares in current.items():
        if name in all_changes and all_changes[name] > 0:
            continuous_increasers.add(name)

continuous_list = sorted(list(continuous_increasers))[:5]

ws4['A2'] = 'Top 5 Most Active Adjustment Institutions'
ws4['B2'] = str(top5_active)
ws4['A3'] = 'List of Large Institutions with Continuous Increase'
ws4['B3'] = str(continuous_list)

print(f'  Top 5 Active: {top5_active}')
print(f'  Continuous Increasers: {continuous_list}')

    decrease_count = 0
    exit_count = 0
    large_adj_count = 0
    net_inflow = 0.0

        for name, shares in current_holders.items():
            if name in prev_quarter_data:
                change = shares - prev_quarter_data[name]
                if change > 0:
                    increase_count += 1
                    if abs(change) > 10:
                        large_adj_count += 1
                    net_inflow += change * prices[q] / 1000
                elif change < 0:
                    decrease_count += 1
                    if abs(change) > 10:
                        large_adj_count += 1
                    net_inflow += change * prices[q] / 1000
            else:
                new_count += 1
                net_inflow += shares * prices[q] / 1000
        for name in prev_quarter_data:
            if name not in current_holders:
                exit_count += 1
    else:
        new_count = len(holders)
        net_inflow = sum(h[1] * prices[q] / 1000 for h in holders)
    
    ws3[f'A{row}'] = q
    ws3[f'B{row}'] = new_count

ws4['A3'] = 'List of Large Institutions with Continuous Increase'

import openpyxl

# The issue: Exit count was showing 20 for Q2-Q4 because of wrong logic

# Sheet 1 QoQ fix - ensure values are numbers
ws1 = wb['Basic Info & Holding Trend']
prev_total = 0
for qi, q in enumerate(['2023Q1','2023Q2','2023Q3','2023Q4','2024Q1','2024Q2','2024Q3','2024Q4']):
    row = qi + 2
    top20 = ws1[f'E{row}'].value
    top10 = ws1[f'F{row}'].value
    top5 = ws1[f'G{row}'].value
    if qi == 0:
        ws1[f'H{row}'] = 'N/A'
    else:
        qoq = round(float(top20) - float(prev_total), 2)
        ws1[f'H{row}'] = qoq
    prev_total = top20

# Sheet 3 - Recalculate properly with correct logic
prev_data = {}
quarters = ['2023Q1','2023Q2','2023Q3','2023Q4','2024Q1','2024Q2','2024Q3','2024Q4']
for qi, q in enumerate(quarters):
    row = qi + 2
    q_price = float(ws1[f'B{row}'].value)
    
    # Get current quarter holdings from Sheet 2
    current = {}
    for r in range(2, 162):
        cell_a = ws3[f'B{r}'].value
        if ws3.cell(row=r, column=1).value == q:
            name = ws3.cell(row=r, column=2).value
            shares = ws3.cell(row=r, column=3).value
            current[name] = shares
    
    new_count = 0
    increase_count = 0
    decrease_count = 0
    exit_count = 0
    large_adj_count = 0
    net_inflow = 0.0
    
    if prev_data:
        for name, shares in current.items():
            if name in prev_data:
                change = shares - prev_data[name]
                if change > 0:
                    increase_count += 1
                    if abs(change) > 10:
                        large_adj_count += 1
                    net_inflow += change * q_price / 1000
                elif change < 0:
                    decrease_count += 1
                    if abs(change) > 10:
                        large_adj_count += 1
                    net_inflow += change * q_price / 1000
            else:
                new_count += 1
                net_inflow += shares * q_price / 1000
        for name in prev_data:
            if name not in current:
                exit_count += 1
    else:
        new_count = len(current)
        net_inflow = sum(v * q_price / 1000 for v in current.values())
    
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=2).value = new_count
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=3).value = increase_count
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=4).value = decrease_count
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=5).value = exit_count
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=6).value = increase_count - decrease_count
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=7).value = large_adj_count
    ws3.cell(row=row, column=8).value = round(net_inflow, 2)
    
    print(f'  {q}: New={new_count} Inc={increase_count} Dec={decrease_count} Exit={exit_count} Net={increase_count-decrease_count} Large={large_adj_count} Inflow={round(net_inflow,2)}')
